description: Social-sentiment snapshot for one coin: galaxy score (0-100 composite), alt rank (lower is stronger), bullish sentiment %, 24h social volume, social dominance %, and 24h interactions.
name: sentiment_social

altRank.description: Rank among all coins; lower is stronger

bullishSentimentPct.description: Share of bullish social activity, percent; absent when the vendor did not report it

interactions24h.description: Social interactions over 24h, count; absent when not reported

socialDominancePct.description: Share of all crypto social volume, percent; absent when not reported

socialVolume24h.description: Social volume over 24h, count; absent when not reported

title: Social Sentiment
